seo.title: GÖKTÜRK LOJİSTİK — From Turkey to the World
seo.description: GÖKTÜRK LOJİSTİK — International road freight, express transport, cold chain and warehousing services connecting Turkey with Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia.

hero.sub: From Turkey to Europe, from the Caucasus to Central Asia — we cross borders with reliable, uninterrupted road freight.

brand.headline: At Every Point of the Road.
brand.body: A powerful logistics network stretching from Turkey to Europe, from the Caucasus to Central Asia. We move with the same discipline and the same trust at every border, on every route.
brand.tagline: The journey has changed. The spirit remains.

tracker.emptyState: Enter a shipment number or pick an example to see tracking results.

fleet.headline: We Carry Power on the Road.

calculator.disclaimer: * Demo estimate — not a real commercial quotation.

trackingCta.body: Track your shipment instantly with your tracking number, or calculate the estimated distance, duration and CO₂ for your route.

journey.heritageBody: The spirit of movement, freedom and endurance the horse once symbolised in Turkic culture lives on today in the strength that carries us across the road.

driver.body: At every stage of thousand-kilometre journeys, our experienced and reliable drivers are behind the wheel. Göktürk Lojistik's strength comes from the value it places in people.
driver.connectingLine: The resolve the horse once carried for centuries lives on today in the determination behind our drivers' wheels.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Every driver of ours sets out with regular training and strict safety protocols.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Years of field experience on long-distance routes.

support.title: 24/7 Support
support.description: Our operations team is with our drivers at every moment of the journey.

planning.title: Route Planning
planning.description: Meticulous route planning for safe and efficient itineraries.

finalCta.body: Let us carry your cargo safely to every corner of the world.

footer.body: From Turkey to Europe, from the Caucasus to Central Asia — reliable road freight.

karayolu.title: Road Freight
karayolu.description: Full truckload and partial freight transportation between Turkey and Europe.

express.title: Express Transport
express.description: Fast and reliable solutions for time-critical shipments.

otomotiv.title: Automotive Logistics

volvo-fh.tagline: The quiet power of long distance.
volvo-fh.description: The backbone of our tractor fleet, built for maximum fuel efficiency and driver comfort on European routes.

mercedes-actros.description: Equipped with superior power delivery and advanced safety systems for automotive and industrial cargo.

scania-r.tagline: The resilient companion of the eastern corridor.
scania-r.description: Optimised durability for uninterrupted operation across demanding terrain and long border crossings.
